channel.title: CEMS On Demand Mapping News
channel.description: Updates on the latest news articles.

item.title: Rapid Mapping crisis information now available as a Geopackage
item.description: The crisis information is now delivered as a Geopackage (GPKG) to be easily integrated in your geoinformation system.

item.title: Wildfire in Fontainebleau, France
item.description: Activation EMSR894. On 12 July 2026, a wildfire was reported to have affected the Fontainebleau Forest, Ile-de-France, France. The event is ongoing and spreading, with damage reported to affect forestry, while the fire is threatening residential areas and critical transport infrastructure, including the A6 motorway and a nearby village. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, wildfire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.

item.title: Wildfire in Island of Korcula, Croatia
item.description: Activation EMSR893. On 11 July at 14:54, the Dubrovnik County Firefighting Operations Centre received a report of a major wildfire on the island of Korčula, in the Kapja area between the municipalities of Blato and Smokvica. Due to the severity of the situation and strong winds, which caused the fire to spread rapidly, all available ground firefighting resources from the island were deployed, including the Blato, Smokvica, Korčula and Vela Luka Volunteer Fire Departments. A total of 64 firefighters. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, wildfire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.

item.title: Wildfire in Andalusia, Spain
item.description: Activation EMSR892. On the 09 July 2026 at 14:25 a wildfire is reported to have affected Almeria province in Andalusia, Spain. The incident is ongoing. Several inhabited areas have been evacuated and 11 fatalities have been reported. Extensive forested areas, numerous municipalities, and dispersed settlements have created a high-risk Urban-Forest scenario for the population. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, wildfire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.

item.title: Wildfires in Les Gavarres, Spain
item.description: Activation EMSR888. A wildfire that broke out in the municipality of La Bisbal d'Empordà is spreading southward. item.description: Have you ever wondered why some impacts aren't visible on satellite images, or why the damage is likely underestimated?

item.title: Wildfire in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
item.description: Activation EMSR886. On 27/06/2026, a forest fire broke out near Bad Kreuznach in the Rhineland-Palatinate Land, in a wooded area formerly used for military purposes. Therefore considering that the area is contaminated with ammunition, the fire is expected to spread and quickly expand from 3,000 m² initially to 10,000 m². Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide wildfire extent emergency mapping and damage assessment.
